question: Does missing kernel32!GetThreadDescription hang Firefox GetProcInfoSync / Troubleshoot.processes after QueryProcessCycleTime and QueryThreadCycleTime, and how should the export be supplied?

allowedInputs.title: In-tree GetThreadDescription body and SetThreadDescription export

Reported: GetProcAddress(Kernel32, GetThreadDescription) is optional; NULL only skips thread names. CycleTime stubs caused empty-map reject; after CycleTime, hang is elsewhere in GetProcInfoSync (STS), not the missing export.
allowedInputs.note: Reported: serial shows LdrGetProcedureAddress missing export pair; Mozilla resolves dynamically and continues without names
